proposals.title: Independent board chairman
proposals.proponent: John Chevedden, on behalf of Kenneth Steiner
proposals.topic_summary: Requests board adopt policy requiring the Chairman be an independent director whenever possible, with phase-in discretion at the next CEO transition.
proposals.evidence: The Board of Directors recommends that shareholders vote AGAINST this proposal

proposals.title: Oil and gas company and project financing related to the Arctic and the Canadian oil sands
proposals.proponent: Trillium Asset Management LLC, as agent for Oneida Trust Minors
proposals.topic_summary: Requests a report describing how JPMorgan plans to respond to reputational risks from financing Canadian oil sands and Arctic oil and gas exploration.
proposals.evidence: The Board of Directors recommends that shareholders vote AGAINST this proposal for the following reasons

proposals.title: Climate change risk reporting
proposals.proponent: As You Sow, on behalf of Brian Patrick Kariger Revocable Trust
proposals.topic_summary: Requests a report on whether and how JPMorgan will reduce GHG emissions from its lending in alignment with Paris Agreement goals.
proposals.evidence: The Board of Directors recommends a vote AGAINST this proposal.

proposals.title: Amend shareholder written consent provisions
proposals.topic_summary: Requests bylaw amendment allowing any stockholder of record to initiate written consent by requesting the board fix a record date, without the 20% threshold.
proposals.evidence: The Board of Directors recommends a vote AGAINST this proposal.

proposals.title: Charitable contributions disclosure
proposals.topic_summary: Requests the board disclose on the company website any recipient receiving $1,000 or more in direct contributions, excluding employee matching gifts.
proposals.evidence: The Board of Directors recommends that shareholders vote AGAINST this proposal for the following

proposals.title: Gender/Racial pay equity
proposals.proponent: Arjuna Capital, on behalf of Rainer Yingling Judd, Laura J. Ballance and Lucas Jozef Suer
proposals.topic_summary: Requests a report on JPMorgan's global median gender/racial pay gap and associated risks, including recruiting and retaining diverse talent.
proposals.evidence: The Board of Directors recommends a vote AGAINST this proposal.
